notes.title: Bi-Weekly Update #13 - Rotation, Rotation, Rotation
notes.content:
A lot has been added to the playtest these past two weeks! We've got rotations, new shop dragging placement, a new lock system and the decision-making branch has been merged into the main version. We've also got some more QOL changes including showing the stats of unit groups and effects during battle. It's been quite a lot of work implementing these new systems but I think the game, at least for me, has been a lot more fun recently, especially when it comes to creating new builds with the rotated items.



As for the status of the demo I have been considering one more big change regarding Will, but I'd still like some more feedback before making a decision! If you have any thoughts on how the game plays or if there's something you'd like to see dont hesitate to join the Discord. Thanks for reading this update, here's all the new content from the past two weeks.


New Content
✦ Item rotation has been added! Use R or RMB to rotate bought items! 

✦ Shops and encounters have changed with a new system. (Decision making branch has been merged into the main playtest) 

✦ You can now drag units and items directly from the shop onto your board. 

✦ New lock slot system, either drag shop items to lock slots or right click them!

✦ Lock slots now cost 15% of the shop item/groups cost to use. 

✦ Damage and healing of unit groups and various relic/item effects is now tracked and shown during each battle! The visual representation is rough but it works for now. 

✦ Upgrades can be canceled now! 

✦ You can now hide the relic chest screen to take a look at your army. 

✦ Pause menu now contains the compendium (only usable outside of battle). 

✦ Wishlist and Discords buttons have also been added to pause menu.
Other Changes
✦ Removed decision-making beta branch and added V2 beta branch for those who want to see how the game played before.

notes.title: Bi-Weekly? Update #12 - Core Changes
notes.content:
As you might've noticed last week there was no weekly update. I'll be frank... I forgot!

Last weekend was a bit hectic for me so it completely slipped my mind, however this gives me an opportunity to split updates into the more manageable frequency of bi-weekly ones.

So with this in mind, what have I been up to?



The past week I've been testing out some core changes to the game, tweaking how the shop works, how rewards work and laying the ground work of a mechanic I've been debating on adding for a long time. Of course this is all not set in stone but so far I've enjoyed the changes I've made and those who've joined the Discord have been able to try it out early. It's still a bit wonky and incomplete, even for the level of quality I want from the playtest, so if you'd like to try it out you'll find it under the beta versions for the playtest.



The changes were made to help bring more variety, decision-making, and hopefully get the game ready for it's demo and release. So try out the beta branch and tell me what you think!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537418/09c746b872c287e81dcd6337efd2026f697909a1.png"]





P.S. If you read this far, the mechanic I spoke about earlier is....ROTATING items. A staple in inventory management I know, we'll see if it has merit or not! 

P.P.S Don't tell anyone I said this! ːd2tidehunterː

notes.title: Weekly Update #11 - Thank You!
notes.content:
This week has been uneventful from me in terms of updates, but in terms of the games popularity it's been an awesome one! This weekend we just reached 500 wishlists, 600 unique playtesters, and a median playtime of 1 hour! These stats might not mean much to some, but Im really happy to see so many people get to experience Souls End! It really means a lot.



From what I can tell it seems many of the new players are German and found the game through a German youtuber, so Hallo und vielen Dank fürs Spielen! (I dont speak German so please tell me if that's right lol)



On the development side, I've been away from home but managed to get some work done on the enemies for Act 3. I'm still debating on how much content I want to include in the demo but here's a peek at some unfinished art for the enemies you might see in Act 3.

notes.title: Weekly Update #1 - Spells, Poison, and QOL
notes.content:
This past week I've released a few updates to finally bring in some new content and flesh out some cool builds.

Here's all the patch notes, but if you'd like to discuss the game or post your armies try joining the Discord!

✦ Green Dragon Brazier (Uncommon Relic)

✦ Snake Ring (Uncommon Relic)

✦ Gobbo Flute (Rare Relic)

✦ Poisoned Rework

Poisoned is now stackable and deals 1 damage per each stack. This rework intends to address the problem that stemmed from having multiple sources apply poison and there not being any real benefit to do so. Hopefully this will help make Poison builds a whole lot better and improve Grob's identity as a Soul. I intend to do the same to On Fire! as well.

✦ Contagious upgrade now applies 10 stacks of Poisoned when it spreads.

✦ Reinforce now also gives +20 poison application.

✦ Ragnorakian Zerkers

Glory Upgrade reworked! (Now you’ll be choosing between short-term battle heals or long-term damage scaling.)

✦ On Fire!

Now works just like Poisoned—fully stackable. (Expect synergy content updates soon.)

✦ Elder Scale

Now functions like Poisoned Dagger’s Envenomed trait.

notes.title: Playtest Update - Patch Notes v0.2.3
notes.content:
This update is focused entirely on UI improvements and some small quality of life (QOL) features—most notably, auto spell casting! No balance changes or new content just yet, but be on the lookout for some fresh content and more polish (UI, QOL, balance) next week! 

As always, let me know if you encounter any bugs or have thoughts on the new UI and feature changes. Thanks & enjoy the update!  



UI/UX Changes 

✦ Updated Main Menu 

✦ Game Panel Overhaul

✦ New encounter tracker 

✦ Time tracker added 

✦ Health bars moved away from relic space 

✦ Spell area updated for clarity 
✦ Upgrade UI polish pass 

✦ Brand new cursor (Toggleable in settings) with spell cooldown tracker! 

✦ And more!


New Features 

✦ Auto-casting is here! No more mashing Space or clicking—just sit back and blast. 



✦ Placeholder Leveling System: 

You can now level up and see your score at the end of runs. (Leveling doesn't impact gameplay just yet and the level curve/scoring will also likely change in future builds.) 



✦ Added a visual sequence for item effects and unit spawning. 



✦ Events have now become Unknowns. Events now have a chance to be a battle, a relic or a rest!

notes.title: The Playtest is Here!
notes.content:
It’s been a long road, but the first public playtest for Souls End is finally here! Now's the time to get your first taste of this juicy game. I hope you enjoy the experience and if you feel kind enough to give some feedback I'd really appreciate it! The plan for now is to steadily add content until we reach demo status so stay vigilant for patches.

The Goal for this Playtest
The main goals for this playtest are to gather feedback as well as to find any bugs that crop up.

I also want to grow a community that's directly involved in the creation of this game. As a solo dev it's been pretty rough and I think sharing the development process will ultimately make working on Souls End a lot more fun and in the end provide a better game. So, try out the game and if you have anything to say don't hesitate to contact me, I can mainly be found on Discord.

So what's in the Playtest Anyway?
The playtest currently only includes Act 1. It’s a small, focused slice of the game to finally show off what I’ve been cooking.

The game has -

-17 items, each with two upgrades.
-15 relics.
-7 Units, each with two upgrades.
-1 Boss Encounter
-2 Player Characters/Starts (Souls)
-3 Enemy units
-2 Events

With more content coming as fast as I can get it out!

Download the playtest and let me know what you think—your feedback could shape the future of Souls End!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3569020/Souls_End/


Thanks for reading! ːcozycrashfishː
